$comment: ADR-013's performance budget as data (T-4.03). Every asset in the manifest names one class (its source's scene extras, sandline.class) and must be at or under every number of it; `pnpm check:assets` and the tools' tests fail, naming the asset and the number, when one is over. ADR-013's character range is 8–15k triangles and 45–65 bones: only the top of each range is a limit here, because an asset under the range costs nothing (the code-built soldier has 900 triangles and 17 bones; whether the floor means anything is ADR-018's, after the owner chooses). The prop, weapon and kit rows are this task's proposals under ADR-013's draw-call and download ceilings, for the owner to overrule. Textures: every one KTX2, a power of two on each side.
